intro: One large cup of brown sugar bubble tea with fresh milk is about 450 kcal. The calories come from the tapioca pearls, brown sugar syrup and full cream milk.

variants.name: Fruit green tea, 0% sugar, no topping

diet: Yes, but treat it as a treat, not a daily drink. It has about the same calories as a regular plate of nasi lemak. Once a week in a smaller size with less sugar can still fit your plan. If you drink it almost every day, losing weight will be tough.
tips: Choose a medium size and 30% or 50% sugar.
Ask for half pearls, or switch to a lighter topping like aloe jelly.
Plan it as your 'snack' for the day. Don't add kuih or cake on top.

swap.name: Medium milk tea, 30% sugar, no pearls
swap.why: You still get the milk tea taste, at less than half the calories.

faq.q: What are tapioca pearls made of?
faq.a: Cassava starch. They're usually soaked in brown sugar syrup to make them sweet.

faq.q: Why does brown sugar bubble tea have 'tiger stripes' on the cup?
faq.a: Thick brown sugar syrup is dripped along the cup walls before the milk is poured in. This creates the brown stripes.
If it has tea, yes. Some brown sugar fresh milk drinks have no tea, so no caffeine. Ask the shop.
